candidates.english: I went to bed at ten yesterday.

candidates.chinese: 我听着噪音不能睡觉。
candidates.english: I can't sleep with all that noise.

candidates.chinese: 这是我去睡觉的地方。
candidates.english: This is where I sleep.

candidates.chinese: 请安静！孩子们在睡觉。
candidates.english: Be quiet. The kids are asleep.

candidates.chinese: 上床睡觉之前请关灯。
candidates.english: Please turn off the light before you go to sleep.

candidates.chinese: 我的妻子在试图睡觉。
candidates.english: My wife's trying to sleep.

candidates.chinese: 我不能吵，宝宝在睡觉。
candidates.english: I cannot make noise. The baby is sleeping.

candidates.chinese: 我在公交车上睡觉了。
candidates.english: I slept on the bus.

candidates.chinese: 工作之前先收好思绪。
candidates.english: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

candidates.chinese: 工作之后我直接回家。
candidates.english: After work I go straight home.

candidates.chinese: 他無法得到這份工作。
candidates.english: He couldn't get the job.

candidates.chinese: 他白天睡觉，晚上工作。
candidates.english: He sleeps during the day and works at night.

candidates.chinese: 我會活到老工作到老。
candidates.english: I'll work as long as I live.

candidates.chinese: 湯姆得找下一份工作。
candidates.english: Tom will have to find another job.

candidates.chinese: 他從早上工作到夜晚。
candidates.english: He worked from morning until night.

candidates.chinese: 我工作了一整天，很累。
candidates.english: I'm very tired from working all day.

candidates.chinese: 我努力工作养家糊口。
candidates.english: I worked hard in order to support my family.

candidates.chinese: 你把工作做完了沒有？
candidates.english: Are you through with the work?

candidates.chinese: 他年輕時很勤奮工作。
candidates.english: In his younger days he worked very hard.

candidates.chinese: 我必须立刻开始工作。
candidates.english: I must start working at once.

candidates.chinese: 家裡人一起吃了晚飯。
candidates.english: The family ate dinner together.

candidates.chinese: 他順道去了這家書店。
candidates.english: He dropped in at the bookstore.

candidates.chinese: 你是从哪个国家来的？
candidates.english: What country are you from?

candidates.chinese: 昨晚我邻居家着火了。
candidates.english: A fire broke out in my neighborhood last night.

candidates.chinese: 湯姆會在家等我們的。
candidates.english: Tom will be waiting for us at home.

candidates.chinese: 我很抱歉那么晚回家。
candidates.english: I'm very sorry I came home so late.

candidates.chinese: 他十年中第一次回家。
candidates.english: He returned home for the first time in ten years.

candidates.chinese: 他从不把工资带回家。
candidates.english: He never brings the paycheck home.

candidates.chinese: 他是有錢人家的兒子。
candidates.english: He is the son of a wealthy family.

candidates.chinese: 日本是个富有的国家。
candidates.english: Japan is a rich country.

candidates.chinese: 他家的布局非常温馨。
candidates.english: His home is furnished in a very cozy way.

candidates.chinese: 我陪家人度過聖誕夜。
candidates.english: I'm spending Christmas Eve with my family.

candidates.chinese: 他考试失败了，但他不太在意。
candidates.english: He failed the exam, but he doesn't care too much.

candidates.chinese: 我正在准备明天的数学考试。
candidates.english: I am preparing for tomorrow's math exam.

candidates.chinese: 我们下周有一场重要的考试。
candidates.english: We have an important exam next week.

candidates.chinese: 她有勇气去查询考试的结果。
candidates.english: She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.

candidates.chinese: 全部的学生们都考试及格了。
candidates.english: All the students passed the test.

candidates.chinese: 考试不及格意味着再等待一年。
candidates.english: Failing the examination means waiting for another year.

candidates.chinese: 考试后，我们对了一下写的答案。
candidates.english: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.

candidates.chinese: 节日和考试碰巧在同一天。
candidates.english: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.

candidates.chinese: 好好努力，你就能通过考试。
candidates.english: Work hard, and you will pass the examination.

candidates.chinese: 这个学期我们有两次考试。
candidates.english: We have two examinations during this term.

candidates.chinese: 田中先生好像通过了考试。
candidates.english: It seems that Mr Tanaka has passed the exam.

candidates.chinese: 今天我们有一场数学考试。
candidates.english: We had an examination in mathematics today.

candidates.chinese: 我记得我把书还到图书馆了。
candidates.english: I remember returning the book to the library.

candidates.chinese: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。
candidates.english: They've furnished the library with a lot of books.

candidates.chinese: 请不要在图书馆的书上涂写。
candidates.english: Please do not write in this library book.

candidates.chinese: 我突然想到，他可能在图书馆 。
candidates.english: It occurred to me that he might be in the library.

candidates.chinese: 我们学校的图书馆藏书很多。
candidates.english: There are a lot of books in our school's library.

candidates.chinese: 我今天得把这本书还给图书馆。
candidates.english: I have to return this book to the library today.

candidates.chinese: 有时我会在图书馆看见他。
candidates.english: I see him in the library now and then.

candidates.chinese: 我校图书馆藏书二百五十万册。
candidates.english: My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.

candidates.chinese: 她丢了很多的图书馆的书。
candidates.english: She lost many library books.

candidates.chinese: 图书馆是我最喜欢去的地方之一。
candidates.english: The library is one of my favorite places.

candidates.chinese: 图书馆里总是有很多人。
candidates.english: There are always many people in the library.

candidates.chinese: 美国的每个城市都有一个图书馆。
candidates.english: There is a library in every city in America.

candidates.chinese: 拿起這支粉筆，在黑板上寫字。
candidates.english: Take this piece of chalk and write on the blackboard.

candidates.chinese: 老師開始拿萊拉的頭猛擊黑板。
candidates.english: The teacher started hitting Layla's head against the blackboard.

candidates.chinese: 湯姆在黑板上寫了些什麼。
candidates.english: Tom wrote something on the blackboard.

candidates.chinese: 每个人到黑板前写下自己的名字。
candidates.english: Everyone came to the blackboard to write down their name.

candidates.chinese: 湯姆在黑板上寫了什麼？
candidates.english: What did Tom write on the blackboard?

candidates.chinese: 黑板的句子被抹掉了。
candidates.english: The sentence on the blackboard was erased.

candidates.chinese: 她在黑板上寫了什麼？
candidates.english: What did she write on the blackboard?

candidates.chinese: 比較一下你寫的句子和黑板上的句子。
candidates.english: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.

candidates.chinese: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。
candidates.english: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.

candidates.chinese: 黑板需要擦擦了。
candidates.english: The blackboard needs erasing.

candidates.chinese: 請大家看看黑板。
candidates.english: Look at the blackboard, everyone.

candidates.chinese: 我为老师擦黑板。
candidates.english: I erased the blackboard for the teacher.

candidates.chinese: 你可以和我一起练习日语吗？
candidates.english: Can you practice Japanese with me?

candidates.chinese: 是的，你需要每天练习。
candidates.english: Yes, you need to practice every day.

candidates.chinese: 我平时每天可能练习一个小时汉字。
candidates.english: Normally I might study Chinese characters for an hour a day.

candidates.chinese: 她在开始练习。
candidates.english: She's starting to practice.

candidates.chinese: 如果你把你抱怨的时间用在练习篮球上，你或许早已不必抱怨。
candidates.english: If you used the time you spent complaining practicing your basketball, then maybe you would have stopped complaining a long time ago.

candidates.chinese: 可想而知我在学汉字上花太多时间，所以我应该更好地练习语言的其他方面。
candidates.english: It's obvious that I spend too much time studying Chinese characters, so I ought to study other aspects of the language more.

candidates.chinese: 并不是我不喜欢你的英语，只是对我而言，利用每一个可能的机会来练习俄语很重要。
candidates.english: It's not that I don't like your English, but for me it's important to use every opportunity to practise Russian.

candidates.chinese: 你应该去上婴儿心肺复苏课程。
candidates.english: You should really take an infant CPR class.

candidates.chinese: 所以你也打算选这门课程啊！
candidates.english: So you're planning to follow this course as well!

candidates.chinese: 她在夜校上自卫术课程。
candidates.english: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.

candidates.chinese: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。
candidates.english: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.

candidates.chinese: 当我到学校的时候，课程已经结束了。
candidates.english: By the time I arrived at the school, the class had already finished.

candidates.chinese: 明天是运动会的排练，没有往常的课程。
candidates.english: Tomorrow there will be no normal lessons, in view of the athletic meet rehearsal.

candidates.chinese: 课程下周开始。
candidates.english: Classes begin next week.

candidates.chinese: 这样辉煌的成绩，是如何取得的？
candidates.english: How can one achieve such brilliant results?

candidates.chinese: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
candidates.english: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.

candidates.chinese: 不管缺点怎么多，成绩还是最主要的。
candidates.english: No matter how many faults there are, our achievements are the main thing.

candidates.chinese: 他的学习成绩很好。
candidates.english: He has a good school record.

candidates.chinese: 她英语成绩很好。
candidates.english: Her grade in English was very good.

candidates.chinese: 你成绩比我好。
candidates.english: Your grades are better than mine.

candidates.chinese: 尽管他考试成绩不高，但他毕业后还是很成功。
candidates.english: Although his exam scores weren't very high, he was still successful after graduation.

candidates.chinese: 汤姆的科学成绩比班上的任何一个人都要好。
candidates.english: Tom is better at science than anyone else in his class.

candidates.chinese: 我希望可以更紧张我的成绩，但是似乎在我生命的某一刻，我决定它将不再那么重要了。
candidates.english: I wish I could care more about my grades but it seems that, at a certain point of my life, I decided they wouldn't be so important anymore.

candidates.chinese: 假如你在老师讲课的时候再集中一点去听讲的话，你应该就能弄明白了。
candidates.english: If you'd listen a little more carefully to what the teacher says, you'd probably be able to understand.

candidates.chinese: 对不起，我忘了作业这回事了。
candidates.english: I'm sorry, I forgot to do my homework.

candidates.chinese: 我眯了一会之后把作业写了。
candidates.english: I did my homework after I took a nap.

candidates.chinese: 交作业的截止日期是下周一。
candidates.english: The homework is due next Monday.

candidates.chinese: 我们的老师给作业给得很多。
candidates.english: Our teacher gives out a lot of homework.

candidates.chinese: 老师给我们布置了家庭作业。
candidates.english: The teacher gave us homework.

candidates.chinese: 汤姆拒绝帮玛丽做她的作业。
candidates.english: Tom refused to help Mary do her homework.

candidates.chinese: 我弟弟和我在做俄文作业。
candidates.english: My brother and I are doing Russian homework.

candidates.chinese: 晚饭后，她马上开始做作业。
candidates.english: She started doing her homework right after dinner.

candidates.chinese: 看到这些作业，我毫无压力。
candidates.english: Seeing those tasks, I did not feel the burden.

candidates.chinese: 这个女孩正在做家庭作业。
candidates.english: The girl is doing homework.

candidates.chinese: 抱歉，我把作业落在家里了。
candidates.english: I'm sorry, I left my homework at home.

candidates.chinese: 汤姆因为有很多作业不能外出。
candidates.english: Tom can't go out because he has a lot of homework.

candidates.chinese: 這些都是他的文具。
candidates.english: All of this stationery is his.

candidates.chinese: 哪些文具不值得买？
candidates.english: What stationery isn't worth buying?

candidates.chinese: 这间教室与那间隔着一堵墙。
candidates.english: This classroom is separated from that one by a wall.

candidates.chinese: 进教室的时候请把帽子摘了。
candidates.english: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.

candidates.chinese: 教室裡只剩下幾個學生了。
candidates.english: There were only a few pupils left in the classroom.

candidates.chinese: 教室里没剩下几个学生了。
candidates.english: There aren't many students left in the classroom.

candidates.chinese: 張老師每天在教室教學生中文。
candidates.english: Teacher Zhang teaches Chinese to his students at school every day.

candidates.chinese: 鐘聲一響起，老師就走進了教室。
candidates.english: As soon as the bell rang, the teacher came into the classroom.

candidates.chinese: 老師要求我們每天都打掃教室。
candidates.english: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.

candidates.chinese: 我希望我們的教室有冷氣。
candidates.english: I wish our classroom were air-conditioned.

candidates.chinese: 您昨天为什么离开教室？
candidates.english: Why did you leave the classroom yesterday?

candidates.chinese: 今天教室裡的學生比昨天還要多。
candidates.english: There are many more students in the classroom today than yesterday.

candidates.chinese: 他仍然还在教室里学习。
candidates.english: He is still studying in the classroom.

candidates.chinese: 女孩在教室的角落啜泣。
candidates.english: The girl was sobbing in the corner of the schoolroom.

candidates.chinese: 我们上课时学了九的根是三。
candidates.english: We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.

candidates.chinese: 在上课时不要与他人讲话。
candidates.english: Do not talk to others during class!

candidates.chinese: 他上课的时候一直坐在我的旁边。
candidates.english: When he's in class, he continuously sits next to me.

candidates.chinese: 我们九点上课，可是他九点一刻才来。
candidates.english: We start class at nine o'clock, but he didn’t come until quarter past.

candidates.chinese: 他因为生病没来上课。
candidates.english: He was absent from school on account of illness.

candidates.chinese: 我们明天下午不上课。
candidates.english: We don't have class tomorrow afternoon.

candidates.chinese: 学校8点半开始上课。
candidates.english: School begins at eight-thirty.

candidates.chinese: 我们早上九点上课，可是他八点就来了。
candidates.english: We start class at 9am, but he came as early as 8 o’clock.

candidates.chinese: 你什么时候去上课？
candidates.english: When do you go to class?

candidates.chinese: 我今早上课迟到了。
candidates.english: I was late for class this morning.

candidates.chinese: 我真想不明白为什么约翰上课总是迟到。
candidates.english: I wonder why John is always late for school.

candidates.chinese: 你明天几点上课？
candidates.english: What time does class start for you tomorrow?

candidates.chinese: 大多数学生都在为期末考试复习。
candidates.english: Most students are preparing for the final exams.

candidates.chinese: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
candidates.english: I will try not to interrupt you while you are studying.

candidates.chinese: 我想复习英语。
candidates.english: I would like to brush up my English.

candidates.chinese: 我小孩子时，我放学时打棒球了。
candidates.english: When I was a little child, I used to play baseball after school.

candidates.chinese: 他一放学就回宿舍了。
candidates.english: He went back to the dorm as soon as he finished class.

candidates.chinese: 放学后我打了网球。
candidates.english: I played tennis after school.

candidates.chinese: 你放学以后干什么？
candidates.english: What do you do after school?

candidates.chinese: 她放学后打网球。
candidates.english: She plays tennis after school.

candidates.chinese: 他放学后打棒球。
candidates.english: He played baseball after school.

candidates.chinese: 什么时候放学？
candidates.english: When is school over?

candidates.chinese: 学校3点半放学。
candidates.english: School is over at 3:30.

candidates.chinese: 昨天我在放学回家的路上突然遇上了一阵大雨。
candidates.english: As I returned from school yesterday, I was caught in a sudden shower.

candidates.chinese: 在放学回家的路上，我拜访了Nancy家。
candidates.english: I called at Nancy's house on my way home from school.

candidates.chinese: 当汤姆开着他破旧的雷泽车来接女儿放学时，他的女儿假装不认识他。
candidates.english: Tom's daughter pretended not to know him when he came to pick her up from school in his battered old car.

candidates.chinese: 夜晚大雪纷飞。第二天早上，祖母和孙子一起坐着雪橇上街。在放学后的下午，公园里的雪仗开始了。
candidates.english: Plenty of snow had fallen overnight. The following morning, grandmothers and their grandchildren on sledges appeared in the streets, and in the afternoon, after school, snowball fights broke out in the park.

candidates.chinese: 在美国，校车是黄色的。
candidates.english: In the United States, school buses are yellow.

candidates.chinese: 问题是那天我们的车不能用。
candidates.english: The problem is we can't use our car on that day.

candidates.chinese: 问题是 我没什么要跟他说的。
candidates.english: The problem was that I had nothing to say to him.

candidates.chinese: 我不在讨论这个问题的状态。
candidates.english: I am not in a situation to discuss this problem.

candidates.chinese: 让我们来澄清一下这个问题。
candidates.english: Let's clear up this problem.

candidates.chinese: 让我们马上讨论这个问题吧。
candidates.english: Let's discuss the matter right now.

candidates.chinese: 我喜欢把复杂的问题简单化。
candidates.english: I like simplifying complex problems.

candidates.chinese: 如果有问题，请举起你的右手。
candidates.english: If you have a question, please raise your right hand.

candidates.chinese: 我一有问题就用谷歌查一下。
candidates.english: Whenever I have a question, I just Google it.

candidates.chinese: 这个问题对我来讲很难回答。
candidates.english: It is difficult for me to answer the question.

candidates.chinese: 你敢问他有关事故的问题吗？
candidates.english: Dare you ask him about the accident?

candidates.chinese: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
candidates.english: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.

candidates.chinese: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。
candidates.english: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.

candidates.chinese: 她給了我們一個模糊的答案。
candidates.english: She gave us a vague answer.

candidates.chinese: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
candidates.english: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

candidates.chinese: 他的答案要看他的心情而定。
candidates.english: His answer depends on his mood.

candidates.chinese: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。
candidates.english: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.

candidates.chinese: 考试后，我们对了一下写的答案。
candidates.english: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.

candidates.chinese: 嚴格地說，他的答案並不對。
candidates.english: Strictly speaking, his answer is not correct.

candidates.chinese: 看看我的答案是不是對的。
candidates.english: See if my answer is correct.

candidates.chinese: 他對這個問題給了正確的答案。
candidates.english: He gave correct answers to the questions.

candidates.chinese: 這條問題的答案全是錯的。
candidates.english: All the answers to this question were wrong.

candidates.chinese: 他的答案取決於他的心情。
candidates.english: His answer depends on his mood.

candidates.chinese: 我只想要一个明确的答案。
candidates.english: I just want a clear answer.

candidates.chinese: 把你的答案和老师的比较一下。
candidates.english: Compare your answers with the teacher's.

candidates.chinese: 口语比书面语更贴近生活。
candidates.english: Spoken language is closer to life than written language.

candidates.chinese: 虽然他考得很好，他口语的汉语不见得比你的好。
candidates.english: Although he did well in the exam, his spoken Chinese is not necessarily as good as yours.

candidates.chinese: 这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。
candidates.english: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.

candidates.chinese: 我对汤姆要持之以恒地学习法语口语这件事很怀疑。
candidates.english: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.

candidates.chinese: 其实，书面语我搞得相当好，但是口语中，我经常会记不起来某个字的音调。
candidates.english: I'm actually relatively good at written language, but with spoken language I often can't remember the tone on some word.

candidates.chinese: 一公斤的番茄酱等于两公斤的西红柿。
candidates.english: A kilo of ketchup is equivalent to two kilos of tomatoes.

candidates.chinese: 她在她花园里种西红柿。
candidates.english: She grows tomatoes in her garden.

candidates.chinese: 梅格买了一罐西红柿。
candidates.english: Meg bought a can of tomatoes.

candidates.chinese: 茄子，胡萝卜，西红柿。
candidates.english: Eggplant, carrot, tomato.

candidates.english: Modern healthy eating experts put emphasis on eating wholemeal bread and eating more vegetables.

candidates.chinese: 十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。
candidates.english: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.

candidates.chinese: 那个胖女孩吃了太多含高糖份的饮食。
candidates.english: That fat girl consumes too much sugary food.

candidates.chinese: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
candidates.english: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.

candidates.chinese: 我不喜欢油腻的饮食。
candidates.english: I don't like a fat diet.

candidates.english: A sports bra should only be worn for working out, and not in any non-sports situations.

candidates.english: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.

candidates.chinese: 不能过度运动，要量力而行，否则反而对身体造成负面影响。
candidates.english: Don't exercise excessively; do it within your limits, otherwise it may have negative effects on your body.

candidates.english: This contract is null and void.
